scripts.dev: npm run dev:ports:free && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm run dev:ports:free && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
